context: Two friends chat about music and hobbies
purpose: Teach: 伴奏/ダンサー/路面/アルファベット/質量/だらだら/燃費/ツーリング

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ピアノの伴奏、結婚式で、頼まれたよ、嬉しい。
lines.en: Aoi, they asked me to do piano accompaniment for a wedding. I'm really happy about it.
lines.style: Warm, open-hearted. A quick bright attack on the good news. Genuine pleasure, no performance. Slight rise at the end—inviting her in.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。プロのダンサーの公演、行きたいなって思ってるの、私。
lines.en: Yeah. There's this professional dancer's performance I've been thinking about going to.
lines.style: Thoughtful, a little distant. Trails into her own thoughts mid-sentence. Not quite committing yet, testing the idea aloud first.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今朝、路面、凍ってて、滑りそうだったよ、危なかった。
lines.en: The pavement was frozen this morning—I almost slipped. It was scary.
lines.style: Light wry observation, but real concern underneath. Conversational, not dwelling. Quick beat on the danger, then moving past it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 看板、アルファベット、目立たせて、可愛いね、葵のお店。
lines.en: Your shop's sign is really cute with those big letters standing out like that.
lines.style: Genuinely appreciative, warmth in the noticing. Soft smile in the voice. Not overdoing it—sincere admiration that lands gently.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 物理の本、質量の単位、難しいよね、読んでて、頭痛い。
lines.en: This physics book is so hard. The part about mass units is giving me a headache.
lines.style: Wry frustration with a self-aware edge. Not complaining—almost amused at how her brain is resisting. Slight exhale of defeat.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 休日、私、家で、だらだら過ごしちゃうのよね、最近。
lines.en: I've been just lounging around at home on my days off lately. It's become a bad habit.
lines.style: Reflective, a touch self-aware about the laziness. Not apologetic, just noticing the pattern. Slow, comfortable pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 新しい彼の車、燃費、いいって、自慢してたよ、彼。
lines.en: His new car has great fuel efficiency. He was pretty proud about it.
lines.style: Light, affectionate amusement. A small gentle laugh underneath. Not mocking—she finds his pride endearing, even if it's about something practical.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: バイクのツーリング、今度、一緒に、行きたいね、メイちゃん。
lines.en: Next time, let's go on a bike tour together, Mei. I'd really like that.
lines.style: Eager but not rushed. Open invitation, warmth underneath. Slight lean forward in the voice. Genuine want, not just being nice.
